method: Alternating frozen installed wheels and matching Cop source snapshots; three normal fresh processes per application/stage, one separately instrumented worker process per stage. Build timing/tracing excludes app imports and configuration but includes get_container composition; peak RSS covers the whole process.

manifest.source_provenance: Baseline diff captured before step1 edits; dependency wheel bytes are authoritative. App snapshot contains pinned Cop source plus previously authorized composition changes.
